name: week
title: Legal spend this week
subtitle: Invoices waiting, guideline breaches and budgets. Demo data is fictional.

sections.title: Invoices to review
sections.sql: select name,firm,matter_number,reviewer,currency,total,flags,at_stake,days_waiting,days_to_due from invoice_queue where status in ('received','in-review') order by at_stake desc

sections.title: Guideline breaches with money at stake
sections.sql: select invoice,firm,line_no,timekeeper_name,rule,at_stake from line_flags where invoice_status in ('received','in-review') and at_stake>0 order by at_stake desc

sections.title: Budgets past the warning level
sections.sql: select name,matter_number,owner,budget,forecast,burn_pct from budget_position where status='open' and burn_pct>=(select budget_warning_pct from settings) order by burn_pct desc

sections.title: What needs attention
sections.note: Waiting invoices, missing budgets and accruals, panel appointments ending.
sections.sql: select issue,record from (select 'Invoice waiting over 10 days' as issue,name as record from invoice_queue where status in ('received','in-review') and days_waiting>10 union all select 'Accrual missing this month',name from accrual_status where this_month is null union all select 'Open matter without a budget',name from matters where status='open' and budget is null) x order by issue,record

name: panel
title: Outside counsel panel review
subtitle: How each firm bills against the rate card and the guidelines.

sections.title: Firm scorecard
sections.sql: select name,country,panel_status,panel_expiry,invoices,billed,approved,reduced,flags,avg_days_to_bill from firm_scorecard order by billed desc

sections.title: Billed rates against the card
sections.sql: select firm,timekeeper_name,classification,billed_rate,card_rate,hours,above_card from rate_variance order by above_card desc

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,record,firm,finding from compliance_findings order by rule
